text.en:
The Commission is hereby authorized to under-
take measures to implement effectively the Continuing Pro-
fessional Education
(CPE) programs adopted by the Boards
(PRBs) under the Commission's supervision and control.
The Commission shall, after consultation with
and upon recommendation of the various Boards, issue the
necessary standardized guidelines and procedures for the
implementation of the
Continuing
Professional
(CPE) programs which shall embody the following:
A. CPE objectives, definition, nature, and rationale.
Creation of
Council, Composition, Term of
Office, Functions of Council, and meetings.
C. CPE Programs and Activities: accreditation of con-
ventions, conferences, seminars, workshops, etc.,
credit requirements, exemptions, and other related
D. Sanctions.

Repealing Clause. -
Any executive issuances,
orders or provisions thereof inconsistent with the prov1-
sions of this Executive
Order are deemed modified or
take effect immediately.
Effectivity. - This Executive Order shall
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of July
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety five
By the President
